relationship_description: Arthur Defensor is the father of Arthur Defensor Jr., both serving as governors of Iloilo province in succession.
Arthur Defensor Jr. succeeded his father Arthur Defensor as governor of Iloilo, continuing the Defensor political dynasty.
Arthur Defensor and Arthur Defensor Sr. are brothers, both involved in Iloilo politics.
Arthur Celeste and Alfredo Celeste are brothers, both serving as mayors in Pangasinan, representing the Celeste dynasty.
Arthur Celeste is the father of Cheryl Celeste, both holding political positions in Pangasinan.
